name: Analiese
source: The niece of the Hierophant Hymnus, who is a lady ruling a major town. Since her late father was the elder brother of Hymnus, she should have become Hierophant instead, but she willingly gave up claims to the position to her uncle and confined herself to her town and library. She is a great intellectual and is one of the few who knows of the ancient lore of the Icons. Her Arcana is The High Priestess.
